{{Quote|Har, har, har! Do you want to hear a good one? I heard some Gungans today saying that they've got some kind of monastery where they train their elite warriors! Elite Gungans? HAR, HAR, HAR! That's hilarious! Wanna know where they claim the temple is?|An RSF security guard, to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:aRsg">{{SWGcite|exp=AED|type=herald|an RSF security guard|Naboo}}</ref>}}
The '''Gungan Warrior Stronghold''' was a [[Gungan/Legends|Gungan]] monastery located in the [[Lianorm Swamp/Legends|Lianorm Swamp]] region of the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]] [[Planet/Legends|world]] of [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]] during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. Under the control of the [[Gungan society|Gungans]], this temple was used as a place to train [[Militiagung/Legends|elite Gungan warriors]]. The location was the site of various Gungan's, including at least one [[Boss/Legends|Boss]] [[General/Legends|general]], and [[War Chief]], as well as several Gungan bombers and guards.<ref name="SWG:GWS" /> After the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], the [[Royal Naboo Security Forces/Legends|Royal Naboo Security Forces]] learnt the existence of the stronghold but some [[Security Guard/Legends|security guards]] remained skeptical about the Gungan warriors trained there.<ref name="SWG:aRsg" /> Around the same time, the biologist [[Ronin Lightrunner]] visited the place while studying [[Veermok/Legends|veermoks]] and befriended with the Gungans.<ref name="SWG:RL">{{SWGcite|exp=AED|type=herald|Ronin Lightrunner|Naboo}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The Gungan Warrior Stronghold was a location in the [[2003]] [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] [[Star Wars Galaxies|''Star Wars Galaxies: An Empire Divided'']],<ref name="SWG:GWS" /> prior to the [[Star Wars video games|game's]] closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref>
